name: AI Alt Text Generator for SEO & Accessibility | AutoAlt
author: webAufstieg GmbH

sections.description:
Stop losing traffic AND risking fines. Every image without alt text costs you twice: lost Google Image Search visibility AND potential EAA fines (EU) or ADA lawsuits (USA).

AutoAlt generates SEO-optimized, accessible alt texts in seconds – fully WCAG 2.1 AA compliant.

🚨 Why You Need This NOW

  • EAA Deadline June 28, 2025 – EU accessibility requirements take effect
  • ADA Lawsuits at Record High – Website accessibility cases increasing yearly
  • Google Image Search – A significant traffic source for e-commerce stores

✨ Key Features

  • AI-Powered Alt Texts – Natural, descriptive, SEO-optimized
  • Bulk Processing – Process your entire media library at once
  • Smart Keywords – Add mandatory terms, block unwanted keywords
  • 100+ Languages – German, English, French, Spanish, and more
  • All Image Formats – JPG, PNG, WEBP, SVG, GIF, AVIF
  • WCAG 2.1 AA Compliant – Automatic accessibility compliance
  • WooCommerce Ready – Full product image support

🇩🇪 Made in Germany

AutoAlt is developed by webAufstieg GmbH in Aalen, Germany. Your image data is processed with strict privacy standards:

  • GDPR Compliant – German company, EU data protection
  • No Data Storage – Images processed, then deleted
  • German Support – Real humans, real help

🔌 How It Works

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Enter your email to create a free account
  3. Click “Generate” on any image – done!

Works in Media Library, Post Editor, and WooCommerce Product pages.

Demo Video

Additional Information

Privacy Policy

AutoAlt processes images using AI services (OpenAI, Google). Only image data is transmitted – no personal data, no metadata, no EXIF data. Images are not stored after processing. For details, see our Privacy Policy.

Terms of Service

By using AutoAlt, you agree to our Terms of Service.

Credits

  • Developed by webAufstieg GmbH
  • AI powered by OpenAI and Google
  • Icon design by AutoAlt team
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New in your WordPress admin
  2. Search for “AutoAltai”
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate
  4. Go to Settings → AutoAlt and enter your email
  5. Click “Create Account” – your API key is auto-configured
  6. Start generating alt texts!

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  3. Upload the ZIP and click Install Now
  4. Activate and configure as above

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.8 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • Active internet connection
sections.faq:
Is AutoAlt compliant with EAA and ADA?

Yes! All generated alt texts automatically meet WCAG 2.1 Level AA standards, which is the technical requirement behind both the European Accessibility Act (EAA) and Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA).

Are my images stored or used for AI training?

No. Your images are processed once to generate alt text, then immediately deleted. We never store your images or use them for AI training. We use OpenAI and Google AI for processing – only image data is transmitted, no metadata.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes! AutoAlt fully integrates with WooCommerce. Generate alt texts for product images, gallery images, and variation images directly from the product edit screen.

What languages are supported?

AutoAlt supports 100+ languages including: German, English, French, Spanish, Italian, Dutch, Polish, Portuguese, Swedish, Danish, Japanese, Chinese, Korean, and more.

Can I control which keywords appear in alt texts?

Yes! AutoAlt offers Smart Keyword Control:
* Add mandatory keywords (brand names, product categories)
* Block unwanted keywords (competitor names, irrelevant terms)
* Customize the AI prompt for your brand voice

How fast is the alt text generation?

2-3 seconds per image. Bulk processing runs in the background and handles large libraries efficiently.

Will I lose alt texts if I deactivate the plugin?

No. Generated alt texts are stored in your WordPress database as standard image metadata. They remain even if you deactivate or uninstall AutoAlt.

Who is behind AutoAlt?

AutoAlt is developed by webAufstieg GmbH, a German company based in Aalen, Baden-Württemberg. We provide support in German and English.

Where can I get support?

  • Documentation: https://www.autoalt.ai/docs/wordpress/
  • Email: support@autoalt.ai
  • Response time: Usually within 24 hours (business days)

See our FAQ for answers to our most common questions.
